claim_reproduced: Required-family presence plus concurrency/fence invariants do not imply pairwise action-level or order-sensitive coverage.
counterhypothesis: Current WP1208 authored cases may already happen to cover the relevant real factor interactions sufficiently; the synthetic counterexample proves non-implication, not deficiency of the actual current case set.

external_primary_support.relevance: Covering arrays measure combinations of parameter values; family presence alone is not such a coverage guarantee.
Sequence covering methods explicitly cover t-way event orders; unordered/event-presence coverage is distinct.
external_primary_support.source: NIST Combinatorial Methods for Event Sequence Testing (Kuhn et al., ICST 2012)

interpretation.inference: A deterministic derived ChaosCoveragePlan/ChaosSequenceCoverage measurement can add information without changing accepted WP1208 G1 authority.
interpretation.not_proven: No target-twin bug was found; no runtime benefit, fault-detection uplift, token/runtime saving, or architecture acceptance was measured.
interpretation.observed: A family-complete, fence-bearing structural test design can be interaction-incomplete even before any host execution.

next_gate.acceptance: Coverage-guided selection must improve declared constrained t-way and/or sequence coverage without losing mandatory sentinels, then target execution must measure whether that produces useful unique violations or smaller counterexamples.
next_gate.falsifier: If actual current cases already achieve the preregistered coverage or coverage-guided selection adds bookkeeping with no additional diagnostic yield at equal budget, do not promote the selector.
next_gate.recommended: E4_F2_ABLATION on the actual immutable WP1208 candidate pool at equal case/event budget, if an admitted executable target-twin surface and separate atomic E4 claim are available.

source_observations: WP1208 requires every HostileChaosCase to contain all five REQUIRED_FAULT_FAMILIES.
WP1208 requires at least one cross-family concurrent offset and at least one generation-invalidating authority fence.
Those invariants do not define or measure t-way action-level combination coverage or t-event order coverage.
